```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)
library(stringr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Load the model
temp_env <- new.env()

load("../results/Real Application/my_environment.RData", envir = temp_env)

model_SiteEffect <- temp_env$model_SiteEffect
model <- up2date(temp_env$model)

rm(temp_env)
```

## Model Comparation

```{r cars}
anova(model, model_SiteEffect)
```

## Model Diagnosis

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# Model Diagnosis for model_SiteEffect
res_RESite <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = model_SiteEffect,   #Your glmmTMB object
  n = 1000              # Normally in 500–1000
) 

## Residual plot: dunn-smyth vs predicted values
fitted_values <- fitted(model_SiteEffect)
dunn_smyth_residuals <- residuals(model_SiteEffect, type = "dunn-smyth")

plot(
  fitted_values,
  dunn_smyth_residuals,
  pch = 16,
  col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.35),
  xlab = "Fitted values",
  ylab = " Dunn-Smyth residuals"
)

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

lines(
  lowess(fitted_values, dunn_smyth_residuals),
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2
)

## Further check if there is a decreasing variance
DHARMa::plotResiduals(
  res_RESite,
  rank = TRUE,
  absoluteDeviation = TRUE,
  quantreg = TRUE
)
```

## Community Choice
```{r}
# eta_T_hat
nd <- model_SiteEffect$frame
nd$id[] <- NA
nd$site[] <- NA
eta_T_hat <- predict(model_SiteEffect, 
                     newdata = nd,
                     type = "link",
                     re.form = NULL)

Link_data <- data.frame(
  Community = model_SiteEffect$frame$com,
  Link = eta_T_hat
)
boxplot(Link ~ Community, data = Link_data)

# Define rare species
Abund_OA_data <- 
  unique(Link_data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
    Community == 'OA'
  ))
Abund_OA <- plogis(Abund_OA_data$Link)
TruePara <- Abund_OA
names(TruePara) <- levels(model_SiteEffect$frame$sp)

Ratio_Rara <- mean(Abund_OA < (1/64))
print(Ratio_Rara)
```
## Tree with tip lables corrected
```{r}
my.sample <- read.csv(
  "../data/community data.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  

tree <- read.tree("../data/example.tre")

# Convert underscores in tree tip labels to periods to match the community data.
tree_species <- str_replace_all(
  tree$tip.label,
  "_",
  "."
)

community_species <- colnames(my.sample)

# Identify tree species whose names do not have a unique match in the
# community dataset.
unmatched_index <- which(
  !tree_species %in% community_species
)

# Manually correct known species-name mismatches.
tree_species[unmatched_index] <- c(
  "Astragalus.dasyanthus.exscapus",
  "Populus.alba...P..x.canescens",
  "Capsella.bursa.pastoris",
  "Festuca.rupicola.valesiaca",
  "Stipa.borysthenica.capillata"
)

tree$tip.label <- tree_species
```

## Factor Loadings
```{r}
report_obj <- model_SiteEffect$obj$env$report(model_SiteEffect$fit$parfull)
# Inspect all reduced-rank loading matrices
length(report_obj$fact_load)
lapply(report_obj$fact_load, dim)
# Loadings for the first rr() term
Lambda <- report_obj$fact_load[[3]]
rownames(Lambda) <- levels(model_SiteEffect$frame$sp)
```

## Save variables for simulation
```{r}
# Save the three objects
save(
  TruePara,
  tree,
  Lambda,
  file = file.path("../data", "Para_PCV.RData")
)
```
